summary: Read your Inoreader feeds on your Kobo.
page_description: Bring unread Inoreader articles to your Kobo, read them without Wi-Fi, and send your read marks and stars back when it returns.
release_notes: Initial release: unread, starred and recently read articles saved for offline reading; read marks and stars queued while offline.

steps.text: In Inoreader, open Preferences, Developer, and create an application with scope read and write. Keep its App ID and App Key on your computer only.
On your computer, mint a token once with the app's script; it prints a consent page to open and stores the token under ~/.config/cobalt/secrets.
Install the token under the exact name inoreader; the runtime sends it as an Authorization: Bearer header.
Tokens expire. When the app says Inoreader rejected the token, refresh and install again from your computer.
